board.note: Identity as the repository records it for the only supported target. The descriptor as a whole is INFERRED: every value below is transcribed from existing code and docs, none was re-measured when this file was written.

soc.family.note: The code comment calls the MMIO map Glymur-specific; the family name is the repository's own convention for this SoC.

soc.midr.note: MIDR_EL1 0x512f0021 read with probes/run.py idregs. Only this one stepping is recorded, so the mask is exact; other steppings stay unaccepted rather than guessed.

clusters.count.note: Not stated in code. The GICR window holds 18 redistributors and qualify-a16-cpu-policy.py speaks of an 18-core A16, but the split into clusters is not recorded.

clusters.mpidr.note: BOOT_RELOCATE_AFFINITY and BOOT_RELOCATE_CLUSTER, the masks the secondary-CPU relocation compares MPIDR_EL1 under.

gic.version.note: The code refuses to run unless the inventory reports the measured GICv4 distributor at 0x17000000, and its comment calls this a GICv4 implementation.

gic.gicd.note: The base is the surveyed fingerprint value. The 0x10000 size is the architected 64 KiB distributor frame, not a value the code states.

gic.gicr.note: First 0x17080000, end 0x17500000, stride 0x40000: 18 redistributors, as the secondary-CPU path validates them at run time.

gic.its.note: No ITS frame is recorded in code.

timer.ppi.note: Only the EL2 hypervisor timer, INTID 26, is recorded; the other three stay null.

pcie.ecam.note: compat/qcc2072-wifi.h:59 records one endpoint's configuration page, not the ECAM window or its bus range.

limits.ipa_bits.note: S2_TXSZ 28u is a 36-bit intermediate physical address space, a property of this monitor, read from its source.

smmu.note: The GPU SMMU at 0x03da0000 (compat/adreno.h:69) lies inside the adreno window and has no separate size; the PCIe SMMU base is not recorded.

ranges.dram0.note: No A16 DRAM map is recorded in code.

ranges.adreno.note: ADRENO_PA to ADRENO_END. The window includes the GPU SMMU frames.

ranges.i2c-keyboard.note: One 4 KiB controller page; the header cites the A16 DSDT and glymur.dtsi.

ranges.i2c-touchpad.note: One 4 KiB controller page; the header cites the A16 DSDT and glymur.dtsi.

ranges.qcc2072-bar0.note: The endpoint as UEFI leaves it, per the header's hardware note.

devices.gpu.note: The monitor already mediates this window.

devices.display.note: compat/dpu-intf.h:20 gives the MDSS base but no size, so no range is claimed.
